instruction: Insert a new slide after the first slide with the title 'Baseball Equipment'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires inserting a new slide at position 1 with title. Evaluator checks slide count >= 2 and title of second slide.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all three requirements: (1) new slide inserted (checks slide count >= 2), (2) slide positioned after first slide (checks index 1), (3) slide has correct title (checks 'Baseball Equipment')
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter - directly accesses expected.get('key') without incorrectly accessing expected.get('rules')
Postconfig appropriately saves file with Ctrl+S before extraction, ensuring file state is current
Data flow is correct: get_vm_file extracts PPTX -> metric loads with python-pptx -> checks slide count and title text
Logic is robust with error handling (try-except block returns 0.0 on failure) and text comparison uses strip() for whitespace tolerance
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor enhancement: Could check shape.placeholder_format.type to specifically verify title placeholder rather than any shape with matching text, but current implementation is acceptable and pragmatic
